sources.snippet: ⚡ Executive Overview Gevva e2b Multimodal is the vision-enabled variant of the Gevva family of System 1 Decision Engines. Built on Google's instruction-tuned multimodal foundation model google/gemma-4-E2B-it, this model pairs a non-autoregressive sequence classification head with Google's frozen SigLIP vision tower and a fully fine-tuned cross-modal projection layer (embed_vision).
